summary: Oragenics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a Regulation FD presentation and press release. The registrant announced that Chief Medical Officer James P. Kelly will present in the Successful Case Studies session at the IPAC-RS 2026 Nasal Innovation Forum on September 17, 2026. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 contain the presentation and press release, posted to the company website. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing condition is stated. This is routine corporate disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb angle; watch only for clinical or regulatory updates.
